Provide a brief description of the changes included in this Pull Request.

Select all that apply.

# Related Issue

If this Pull Request addresses an existing issue, reference it here.

Example:

```
Closes #12
Fixes #34
```

# Changes Made

Describe the major changes included in this Pull Request.

Examples:

- Added a new reconnaissance module
- Improved dashboard rendering
- Optimized DNS resolution

- Updated documentation

# Testing

Describe how you tested your changes.

Examples:

- Ran individual modules
- Executed the full reconnaissance pipeline

If applicable, include the command used for testing.

```bash
python recon.py example.com --all
```

# Checklist

Please confirm the following before submitting.

- [ ] My code follows the project's coding style.
- [ ] I have tested my changes.

- [ ] My changes do not introduce unnecessary dependencies.
